# Dark Matter™

> Dark Matter™ is a haute couture house from another reality. Fashion first, with horror only as the turn. Season 01 runs from 30 September to 28 November 2026: nine collections, twenty-seven shows, a new look every night until the finale.

The site is one page in English, with a Spanish version behind the EN/ES switch. It has three views: The films, The stage and The wallpapers. How the house makes its work is not public.

## The films
- [The muses](https://darkmatters.site/#hall): a hall of screens where the house muses wait: The Silver Bishop, The Red Bride, The Albino and The Machine.
- [The invitation](https://darkmatters.site/#invite): you were not invited. You came anyway.
- [The silhouettes](https://darkmatters.site/#dust): three looks from the new season, made of dust.
- [The film](https://darkmatters.site/#film): twenty-five seconds from the other side.
- [The runway](https://darkmatters.site/#runway): eight worlds, each with its own film.
- [The encounter](https://darkmatters.site/#enc): someone in the audience has not looked at the runway once. Includes a short game, Hold her gaze.
- [The exit](https://darkmatters.site/#exit): questions, a contact form that replies by DM, and the finale.

## The stage
- [The stage](https://darkmatters.site/#live): a show in 3D with the house looks on the screens of an arena. The house makes stage visuals for tours, festivals, fashion shows and launches; quoted by DM.

## The wallpapers
- [The wallpapers](https://darkmatters.site/#wallpapers): ten packs of 32 wallpapers each, for phone (6 lock + 6 home, 1440 × 3120), iPad (3, 2048 × 2732), desktop (4 scenes in 5K, 4K, Full HD and MacBook) and ultrawide (5120 × 1440), with a palette and an install guide. 6 USD per pack, sent to your email after payment. Packs: N° 01 Noir d'Or, 02 Rouge, 03 Ivoire, 04 Possessed, 05 Voile, 06 Inferno, 07 Glacier, 08 Chrome, 09 Or Liquide, 10 Cathédrale.
- [The complete collection](https://darkmatters.site/#collection): all ten packs, 320 wallpapers, 29 USD.
- [Commissions](https://darkmatters.site/#comm): music videos, fashion films and campaign worlds in the house style. Every commission is quoted by DM.
